templates.description: built-in template set generating the code (cpp17 by default): cpp98, cpp11, cpp14, cpp17, cpp20, python, sca-cpp98

transports.description: custom transports offered for remote links, besides the built-in ones

basePort.description: port of the first remote link, the next ones following (default 47000)

remoteDefaults.description: defaults of the addresses of the remote links (default host 127.0.0.1)

binaries.description: executables the top-level modules are split into (each names its own); links between two of them must be remote

items.description: An executable of the project, holding some of its top-level modules

constants.description: named values; their names share the namespace of the types and interfaces

project.description: name of a dependency: the module belongs to that other project

from.description: initiator side (an `out` port; a container's `in` port into its content, an inner `out` port out of it)

project.description: name of a dependency: the module belongs to that other project

to.description: receiver side (an `in` port; an inner `in` port from its container, the container's `out` port from its content)

settings.description: settings of the transport; the fields that apply depend on it

name.description: referenced by `uses` of other dependencies and by link endpoints (`project`)

file.description: file of the other project (project file or IDL file), relative to this one

uses.description: dependencies of this list whose types and interfaces this one uses

indirect.description: only listed because another dependency uses it

shared.description: types, interfaces and constants it defines like another dependency of this list, listed there

types.description: its own types, as last read from it

interfaces.description: its own interfaces, as last read from it

constants.description: its own constants, as last read from it

modules.description: its modules placed on this canvas so that links reach them, with their ports as last read

role.description: out: initiates / sends; in: receives / serves

items.description: Another project this one uses: its types and interfaces share the namespace of the project's own ones, which reference them by name, and links may reach its modules

root.description: module shown with its content; the whole project when absent

layout.description: rects of modules in this view (parent-relative), in place of their `layout` entries

labels.description: direction from each port's handle where its name is drawn, by port name

dependencies.description: canvas position and size of the placed modules of dependencies, by dependency and module path

labels.description: direction from each port's handle where its name is drawn, by port name

orientation.description: port placement: in left / out right (default), or in top / out bottom

links.description: hand-set link shapes, by link name

points.description: bend points, relative to the innermost module holding both ends (absolute at the top level)

from.description: attachment of the source end on its module

at.description: position along the side: 0 left / top, 1 right / bottom

to.description: attachment of the target end on its module

at.description: position along the side: 0 left / top, 1 right / bottom

label.description: where the badges sit along the link: 0 source, 1 target (default: the middle)

default.description: default value: a mapping for a struct or map, a list for an array, vector, list or set, null for an empty optional, an enum value name, a list of bitmask flag names, a one-entry mapping `case: value` for a union; any value for a custom primitive

default value: a mapping for a struct or map, a list for an array, vector, list or set, null for an empty optional, an enum value name, a list of bitmask flag names, a one-entry mapping `case: value` for a union; any value for a custom primitive

oneOf.description: raised by messages and methods (their `raises`), never used as a type

discriminator.description: integer primitive, bool, char or enum

labels.description: discriminator values selecting the case: integers, characters, booleans, enum value names

default.description: held for the discriminator values no case lists

oneOf.description: discriminated union: one of its cases, selected by the discriminator
custom primitive: an opaque type that generators map to a native type

direction.description: in (default): caller → callee; out: callee → caller; inout: both ways

raises.description: exceptions it may raise (names of exception types)

value.description: checked against the type, as default values are

kind.description: class (default): concrete; abstract: may have pure methods; interface: only pure methods, no attributes

bases.description: paths of the modules of this project it derives from, in order

binary.description: name of the binary (`binaries`) it runs in: top-level modules only, inner ones run in their ancestor's

default.description: default value: a mapping for a struct or map, a list for an array, vector, list or set, null for an empty optional, an enum value name, a list of bitmask flag names, a one-entry mapping `case: value` for a union; any value for a custom primitive

static.description: shared by all instances of the module

direction.description: in (default): caller → callee; out: callee → caller; inout: both ways

const.description: not changed by the method (in parameters only)

raises.description: exceptions it may raise (names of exception types)

virtual.description: can be overridden by derived modules

pure.description: pure virtual (`= 0`): not implemented by this module (virtual only)

override.description: overrides a virtual method of a base module (virtual only)

role.description: out: initiates / sends; in: receives / serves

client.description: where the caller connects (tcp, udp, http, websocket, grpc)

server.description: where the callee listens (tcp, udp, http, websocket, grpc)
